description: This file defines Cucumber hooks for managing WebDriver lifecycle in a test automation framework. It sets up a WebDriver before each scenario and quits it afterward.

classes.name: Hooks
classes.description: A class containing Cucumber hooks to initialize and cleanup WebDriver instances around test scenarios.

methods.name: beforeScenario
methods.description: Creates and initializes a WebDriver instance before each Cucumber test scenario.

methods.name: afterScenario
methods.description: Quits the WebDriver instance after each Cucumber test scenario.
